subject: SOC2/SIG request — Nighthawk Labs: access reconstruction & SCIM replay package
messages:
From: Alex Smith <alex.smith@nighthawklabs.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 11:05:00 -0500
Subject: SOC2/SIG artifacts: access history and provisioning snapshots

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Nighthawk's compliance team has asked us for a few artifacts to complete the SIG questionnaire for our January audit window. Specifically they're requesting: a reconstructed access history for the last 90 days for the nighthawk-prod tenant (user join/leave, role changes), a SCIM delta replay covering 15–16 Jan, and a few SAML assertion samples that show NameID and role attributes for logged sessions.

Can Redwood produce these items or point us to an export we can download? We need an initial package by 2027-01-20 to make our audit timeline.

Appreciate a quick note on feasibility and an ETA.

Best,
Alex
Security Ops | Nighthawk Labs

Attachments: none
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alex Smith <alex.smith@nighthawklabs.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC2/SIG artifacts: access history and provisioning snapshots

Alex,

Thanks for the clear ask — we can deliver the package, and will include an access reconstruction, SCIM delta in machine-readable format, and SAML assertion samples. To align expectations:

- Access reconstruction: we'll provide a time-ordered CSV of account lifecycle events (create/deactivate/role-change) plus a short readme of how we generated it. This will include actor, timestamp, source (SCIM/API/console), and role before/after.
- SCIM delta: we'll produce a JSONL replay of the delta events for 2027-01-15 through 2027-01-16 that can be used to rehydrate a test tenant.
- SAML samples: a handful of redacted assertion file samples (NameID, roles, attributes) and notes on any transformations during assertion mapping.

I'm looping in Priyom (platform engineering) to build the SCIM replay and Aditya (security) for the SAML samples and access reconstruction QA. Lauren Bishop from our GRC team may join the final handoff to confirm the SIG mapping.

Target: deliver a draft bundle by 2027-01-18 so you have two days for ingestion ahead of your 2027-01-20 audit milestone. If anything in the ask is larger scope (e.g., full event store export vs. reconstructed CSV), flag it and we'll propose alternatives.

Action items:
- Priyom: generate SCIM delta JSONL and attach a validation checklist.
- Aditya: export SAML assertion samples + redaction notes.
- Vanessa: assemble CSV reconstruction and internal readme; coordinate final packaging to Drive.

Thanks — Vanessa Ortiz
Senior AM, Security & Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Alex Smith <alex.smith@nighthawklabs.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 14:40:00 -0800
Subject: SCIM delta and validation checklist

Vanessa / Alex,

Per Vanessa's plan, attached is the SCIM delta for 2027-01-15 through 2027-01-16. It's output as newline-delimited JSON events (scim_delta_20270115.jsonl). Each event has the SCIM operation (PATCH/ADD/REMOVE), the target user identifier, and a source_event_id for cross-reference to our audit log.

Validation checklist included in-line at the top of the file (and as a separate note):
- Verify count of ADD/REMOVE/PATCH matches expected (event counts: ADD=12, REMOVE=3, PATCH=7)
- Confirm mapping of external_id -> internal_uuid for the tenant
- Run replay with our provided fixture (replay instructions link below)

Replay instructions: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_Nighthawk_Access_Package

I'll also attach a small sample script to replay into a sandbox tenant; let me know if you want the script in Python or Node.

Attachments: scim_delta_20270115.jsonl
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Alex Smith <alex.smith@nighthawklabs.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 16 Jan 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: SAML assertions and RBAC snapshot

Alex / team,

Attached are redacted SAML assertion samples (saml_assertion_samples.txt) that show NameID, session index, and role attribute mappings (we've removed raw PII). Also attached is an RBAC snapshot export (rbac_snapshot_20270116.csv) with current role definitions and user->role bindings at 2027-01-16T04:00:00Z. A couple of notes:

- Our runtime injects a 'redwood_roles' attribute during assertion mapping; the samples include pre- and post-mapping examples.
- Least-privilege review: we've included a short notes section (in the Drive doc) calling out three service accounts with broader-than-expected access; recommended action is role-scope reduction or time-bound elevation.

Drive package: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_Nighthawk_Access_Package

Attachments: saml_assertion_samples.txt, rbac_snapshot_20270116.csv
From: Alex Smith <alex.smith@nighthawklabs.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: security@nighthawklabs.com
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 17:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: SOC2/SIG artifacts: access history and provisioning snapshots

Team — thank you, this looks good. I pulled the SCIM delta and SAML samples from the Drive folder and spot-checked the RBAC snapshot; everything is in the expected format. A couple quick follow-ups for our auditors:

1) Can you add a one-page README that explains how the access reconstruction was generated (queries used, any aggregation/cleaning rules)?
2) For the SCIM replay script, please include a short note on idempotency (what happens if events are applied twice).

If you can drop those two items into the same Drive folder by end of day tomorrow, we should be set for the SIG upload. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Alex
Security Ops | Nighthawk Labs

Attachments: none
